courses.title: People Management for Technical Teams
courses.description: People Management for Technical Teams takes you from the basics of people management to applying it on a realistic IT Head scenario, through short lessons and hands-on practice. Along the way, you'll also get a practical introduction to requirements gathering, enough to use it alongside people management day to day. Expect a practical course, not a lecture-heavy one.
learning_outcomes: Applying people management to a real IT Head scenario
Practicing people management through guided exercises
Getting a working introduction to requirements gathering
Reviewing common mistakes and how to avoid them

courses.title: Disaster Recovery Planning for Practitioners
courses.description: Disaster Recovery Planning for Practitioners goes beyond the basics of disaster recovery planning, for people already working toward a IT Head role. Through a handful of applied exercises and more realistic scenarios, you'll build the kind of judgement that only comes with practice, rather than following a fixed recipe. It's built for people who already have some grounding in disaster recovery planning and want to go further.

alternates.title: People Management Essentials
alternates.description: People Management Essentials walks you through the basics of people management, built for people new to IT Head work. Starting from the essential vocabulary, you'll work through a handful of guided exercises that build a working sense of people management, with no prior experience assumed. Expect short, practical lessons rather than a long project, with just enough depth to get you started.

Practicing people management through guided exercises
